summary: 34 features and 6 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • orleans: add conversation title optimization to grains (075ff13)
  • api: enhance session management with dungeon settings (7960a75)
  • data: add enhanced session and project repository queries (f1841d8)
  • messaging: add event-based session message architecture (e2df479)
  • prompts: add conversation title optimization prompt system (8aaa88d)
  • wizard: add skills component installation support (a5a8a9e)
  • api: enhance session messaging with structured content (564b7c9)
  • claude: enhance AI service with telemetry support (5142ffd)
  • telemetry: add AI and agent telemetry to Orleans grains (50feba0)
  • telemetry: add AI agent telemetry helpers and tag normalizer (11c0151)
  • data: add Linq2DB runtime layer and Relational primitives (a0cf108)
  • auto-compose: enhance auto-compose workflow with pull rebase (0453a6a)
  • hermes: add full permission bypass for Hermes startup (7e9ea94)
  • data: add Linq2DB runtime layer for EF Core repositories (ce7ffeb)
  • auto-compose: add pull rebase before push option (e2aa999)
  • session: add runtime model label and filter Hermes thinking from exports (af58ca8)
  • session: add authoritative processing start timestamp (66f6dd7)
  • telemetry: register OpenTelemetry instrumentation in modules (3c353d1)
  • telemetry: add OpenTelemetry instrumentation module (dee3531)

HagiCode-org/web

  • wizard: add desktop About window auto-popup on final step (9cd678f)
  • hagipower: add viewer auto-growth status with presence heartbeat (5ffe4c4)
  • prompts: add conversation title optimization prompt image recipe (cb8e482)
  • hero: add chat group to dungeon catalog and title optimization prompt (cc6990d)
  • wizard: add Skills CLI component installation support (432468b)
  • chat: add conversation title optimization with default title tracking (004d4f9)
  • settings: change default edit mode to enabled (b3dd5db)
  • git: add pull rebase before push option to auto compose (4dbb527)
  • hagipower: add hero avatar support to popover (1a4a0a6)
  • messages: filter Hermes thinking content from display (e718823)
  • environment: add environment detection service (4bb8d99)
  • code-server: enhance service with session support (dc10be8)
  • processing: add processingStartedAt to status DTO (9be4493)
  • session: add session usage summary to SignalR snapshots (d339e49)
  • conversation: add runtime sidebar for session monitoring (6b41360)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • harden proposal optimization doc references (837cae1)
  • session: add missing contract ownership for GetProcessingStartedAtAsync (e24fa90)

HagiCode-org/web

  • session: add intelligent merge for session detail snapshots (33e22a5)
  • proposal: reorder SignalR sync before session detail display (ff618a1)
  • ui: reset drawer title and description margins (2fcff1a)
  • confirm-dialog: port dialog to body and improve accessibility (4b57379)
